017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.*;
024
025/**
026 * One event of a run-view stream.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * An immutable value with static factories, one per event kind.  Every factory and <c>with*</c> method validates its
030 * argument against the event contract and throws {@link IllegalArgumentException} naming the member, so a producer
031 * finds its bug where it is written.  {@link #toContractMap()} produces the wire form, and {@link #fromMap(Map)} is
032 * its strict inverse.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * A {@link #seq()} of <c>0</c> means the event has not been numbered yet; sources assign it.
036 */
037@SuppressWarnings({
038   "java:S1192" // Wire member names and event keys are protocol literals.
039})
040public final class RunEvent {
041
042   /** The event kinds.  The wire form is lower case. */
043   public enum Kind {
044      /** A step starts or is updated. */ STEP,
045      /** A step ends. */ END,
046      /** A placeholder suite result. */ SUITE,
047      /** One test result. */ TEST,
048      /** Discard a step's suites and tests. */ REPLACE,
049      /** A notable event. */ NOTE,
050      /** The run finished. */ DONE
051   }
052
053   /** The state of a step that has not ended. */
054   public enum StepState {
055      /** The step is running. */ RUNNING,
056      /** The step is blocked on something outside the run. */ WAITING
057   }
058
059   /** The final status of a step. */
060   public enum EndStatus {
061      /** Passed. */ OK,
062      /** Failed. */ FAIL,
063      /** Skipped. */ SKIP
064   }
065
066   /** The status of a test. */
067   public enum TestStatus {
068      /** Passed. */ PASS,
069      /** Failed. */ FAIL,
070      /** Skipped. */ SKIP,
071      /** Errored. */ ERROR
072   }
073
074   /** The level of a note. */
075   public enum Level {
076      /** Informational. */ INFO,
077      /** Warning. */ WARN,
078      /** Error. */ ERROR
079   }
080
081   /** The final status of a run. */
082   public enum DoneStatus {
083      /** Passed. */ OK,
084      /** Failed. */ FAIL,
085      /** Cancelled. */ CANCELLED
086   }
087
088   /** The maximum length of one serialized event. */
089   public static final int MAX_EVENT_CHARS = 65_536;
090
091   /** The maximum length of a step title. */
092   public static final int MAX_TITLE = 200;
093
094   /** The maximum length of a suite or test name. */
095   public static final int MAX_NAME = 512;
096
097   /** The maximum length of a failure message. */
098   public static final int MAX_MSG = 2000;
099
100   /** The maximum length of a stack trace. */
101   public static final int MAX_TRACE = 8000;
102
103   /** The maximum length of a note text. */
104   public static final int MAX_NOTE = 1000;
105
106   /** The largest integer a JSON number can carry exactly. */
107   public static final long MAX_SAFE_INT = 9_007_199_254_740_991L;
108
109   private static final int MAX_COUNT = 1_000_000_000;
110
111   private static final Map<Kind,List<String>> KEY_ORDER = Map.of(
112      Kind.STEP, List.of("id", "title", "n", "status", "rawOffset"),
113      Kind.END, List.of("id", "status", "ms", "exit"),
114      Kind.SUITE, List.of("step", "fw", "suite", "counts", "rawOffset"),
115      Kind.TEST, List.of("step", "fw", "suite", "name", "status", "ms", "msg", "trace", "rawOffset"),
116      Kind.REPLACE, List.of("step"),
117      Kind.NOTE, List.of("level", "text", "href", "step"),
118      Kind.DONE, List.of("status")
119   );
120
121   private final Kind kind;
122   private final long seq;
123   private final Map<String,Object> members;
124
125   private RunEvent(Kind kind, long seq, Map<String,Object> members) {
126      this.kind = kind;
127      this.seq = seq;
128      this.members = members;
129   }
130
131   private RunEvent with(String key, Object value) {
132      var m = new HashMap<>(members);
133      m.put(key, value);
134      return new RunEvent(kind, seq, m);
135   }
136
137   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
138   // Factories
139   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
140
141   /**
142    * Creates a <c>step</c> event.
143    *
144    * @param id The step id.  Must match <c>^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$</c>.
145    * @param title The step title, 1-200 chars.
146    * @return A new event.
147    */
148   public static RunEvent step(String id, String title) {
149      var m = new HashMap<String,Object>();
150      m.put("id", stepId("step", "id", id));
151      m.put("title", text("step", "title", title, 1, MAX_TITLE));
152      return new RunEvent(Kind.STEP, 0, m);
153   }
154
155   /**
156    * Creates an <c>end</c> event.
157    *
158    * @param id The id of a known step.
159    * @param status The final status.
160    * @return A new event.
161    */
162   public static RunEvent end(String id, EndStatus status) {
163      var m = new HashMap<String,Object>();
164      m.put("id", stepId("end", "id", id));
165      m.put("status", wire("end", "status", status));
166      return new RunEvent(Kind.END, 0, m);
167   }
168
169   /**
170    * Creates a <c>suite</c> placeholder event.
171    *
172    * @param step The id of a known step.
173    * @param fw The test framework key.
174    * @param suite The suite name, 1-512 chars.
175    * @param pass The pass count, 0-1,000,000,000.
176    * @param fail The fail count, 0-1,000,000,000.
177    * @param skip The skip count, 0-1,000,000,000.
178    * @return A new event.
179    */
180   public static RunEvent suite(String step, String fw, String suite, int pass, int fail, int skip) {
181      var m = new HashMap<String,Object>();
182      m.put("step", stepId("suite", "step", step));
183      m.put("fw", fw("suite", fw));
184      m.put("suite", text("suite", "suite", suite, 1, MAX_NAME));
185      var counts = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
186      counts.put("pass", count("pass", pass));
187      counts.put("fail", count("fail", fail));
188      counts.put("skip", count("skip", skip));
189      m.put("counts", counts);
190      return new RunEvent(Kind.SUITE, 0, m);
191   }
192
193   /**
194    * Creates a <c>test</c> event.
195    *
196    * @param step The id of a known step.
197    * @param fw The test framework key.
198    * @param suite The suite name, 1-512 chars.
199    * @param name The test name, 1-512 chars.
200    * @param status The test status.
201    * @return A new event.
202    */
203   public static RunEvent test(String step, String fw, String suite, String name, TestStatus status) {
204      var m = new HashMap<String,Object>();
205      m.put("step", stepId("test", "step", step));
206      m.put("fw", fw("test", fw));
207      m.put("suite", text("test", "suite", suite, 1, MAX_NAME));
208      m.put("name", text("test", "name", name, 1, MAX_NAME));
209      m.put("status", wire("test", "status", status));
210      return new RunEvent(Kind.TEST, 0, m);
211   }
212
213   /**
214    * Creates a <c>replace</c> event.
215    *
216    * @param step The id of a known step.
217    * @return A new event.
218    */
219   public static RunEvent replace(String step) {
220      var m = new HashMap<String,Object>();
221      m.put("step", stepId("replace", "step", step));
222      return new RunEvent(Kind.REPLACE, 0, m);
223   }
224
225   /**
226    * Creates a <c>note</c> event.
227    *
228    * @param level The level.
229    * @param text The plain text, 1-1,000 chars.
230    * @return A new event.
231    */
232   public static RunEvent note(Level level, String text) {
233      var m = new HashMap<String,Object>();
234      m.put("level", wire("note", "level", level));
235      m.put("text", text("note", "text", text, 1, MAX_NOTE));
236      return new RunEvent(Kind.NOTE, 0, m);
237   }
238
239   /**
240    * Creates a <c>done</c> event.
241    *
242    * @param status The final run status.
243    * @return A new event.
244    */
245   public static RunEvent done(DoneStatus status) {
246      var m = new HashMap<String,Object>();
247      m.put("status", wire("done", "status", status));
248      return new RunEvent(Kind.DONE, 0, m);
249   }
250
251   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
252   // Optional members
253   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
254
255   /**
256    * Sets the display ordinal of a <c>step</c> event.
257    *
258    * @param n The ordinal, 1-9999.
259    * @return A copy with the member set.
260    */
261   public RunEvent withN(int n) {
262      requireKind("n", Kind.STEP);
263      if (n < 1 || n > 9999)
264         throw iaex("RunEvent step n must be 1-9999; got '%s'", n);
265      return with("n", n);
266   }
267
268   /**
269    * Sets the state of a <c>step</c> event.
270    *
271    * @param state The state.
272    * @return A copy with the member set.
273    */
274   public RunEvent withState(StepState state) {
275      requireKind("status", Kind.STEP);
276      return with("status", wire("step", "status", state));
277   }
278
279   /**
280    * Sets the raw byte offset of a <c>step</c>, <c>suite</c> or <c>test</c> event.
281    *
282    * <p>
283    * The 0-based offset into the raw output log of the start of the line that produced the event; a terminal view
284    * scrolls to it.
285    *
286    * @param offset The offset, 0 to 9007199254740991.
287    * @return A copy with the member set.
288    */
289   public RunEvent withRawOffset(long offset) {
290      requireKind("rawOffset", Kind.STEP, Kind.SUITE, Kind.TEST);
291      if (offset < 0 || offset > MAX_SAFE_INT)
292         throw iaex("RunEvent %s rawOffset must be 0-%s; got '%s'", wireName(kind), MAX_SAFE_INT, offset);
293      return with("rawOffset", offset);
294   }
295
296   /**
297    * Sets the duration of an <c>end</c> or <c>test</c> event.
298    *
299    * @param ms The duration in milliseconds, 0 to 9007199254740991.
300    * @return A copy with the member set.
301    */
302   public RunEvent withMs(long ms) {
303      requireKind("ms", Kind.END, Kind.TEST);
304      if (ms < 0 || ms > MAX_SAFE_INT)
305         throw iaex("RunEvent %s ms must be 0-%s; got '%s'", wireName(kind), MAX_SAFE_INT, ms);
306      return with("ms", ms);
307   }
308
309   /**
310    * Sets the process exit code of an <c>end</c> event.
311    *
312    * @param exit The exit code.
313    * @return A copy with the member set.
314    */
315   public RunEvent withExit(int exit) {
316      requireKind("exit", Kind.END);
317      return with("exit", exit);
318   }
319
320   /**
321    * Sets the failure message of a <c>test</c> event.
322    *
323    * @param msg The message, at most 2,000 chars.
324    * @return A copy with the member set.
325    */
326   public RunEvent withMsg(String msg) {
327      requireKind("msg", Kind.TEST);
328      return with("msg", text("test", "msg", msg, 0, MAX_MSG));
329   }
330
331   /**
332    * Sets the stack trace of a <c>test</c> event.
333    *
334    * @param trace The trace, at most 8,000 chars.
335    * @return A copy with the member set.
336    */
337   public RunEvent withTrace(String trace) {
338      requireKind("trace", Kind.TEST);
339      return with("trace", text("test", "trace", trace, 0, MAX_TRACE));
340   }
341
342   /**
343    * Sets the link of a <c>note</c> event.
344    *
345    * @param href An absolute http(s) URL or a same-origin path.
346    * @return A copy with the member set.
347    */
348   public RunEvent withHref(String href) {
349      requireKind("href", Kind.NOTE);
350      if (! RunViewChecks.isNoteHref(href))
351         throw iaex("RunEvent note href must be an absolute http(s) URL or a same-origin path; got '%s'", RunViewChecks.clip(href));
352      return with("href", href);
353   }
354
355   /**
356    * Sets the step a <c>note</c> belongs under.
357    *
358    * @param step A step id.
359    * @return A copy with the member set.
360    */
361   public RunEvent withStep(String step) {
362      requireKind("step", Kind.NOTE);
363      return with("step", stepId("note", "step", step));
364   }
365
366   /**
367    * Returns a copy with the sequence number set.
368    *
369    * @param seq The sequence number, 1 to 9007199254740991, or 0 for unassigned.
370    * @return A copy.
371    */
372   public RunEvent withSeq(long seq) {
373      if (seq < 0 || seq > MAX_SAFE_INT)
374         throw iaex("RunEvent seq must be 0-%s; got '%s'", MAX_SAFE_INT, seq);
375      return new RunEvent(kind, seq, members);
376   }
377
378   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
379   // Accessors and wire form
380   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
381
382   /**
383    * Returns the event kind.
384    *
385    * @return The kind.
386    */
387   public Kind kind() {
388      return kind;
389   }
390
391   /**
392    * Returns the sequence number.
393    *
394    * @return The sequence number, or <c>0</c> when unassigned.
395    */
396   public long seq() {
397      return seq;
398   }
399
400   /**
401    * Returns the event in its wire form.
402    *
403    * <p>
404    * The map is ordered (<c>ev</c>, <c>seq</c> when assigned, then the members in contract order) and omits unset
405    * optional members.  A fresh map is returned on every call.
406    *
407    * @return The wire map.
408    */
409   public Map<String,Object> toContractMap() {
410      var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
411      m.put("ev", wireName(kind));
412      if (seq > 0)
413         m.put("seq", seq);
414      for (var key : KEY_ORDER.get(kind)) {
415         var v = members.get(key);
416         if (v == null)
417            continue;
418         if (v instanceof Map<?,?> c)
419            v = new LinkedHashMap<>(c);
420         m.put(key, v);
421      }
422      return m;
423   }
424
425   /**
426    * Checks that the serialized event fits in {@link #MAX_EVENT_CHARS}.
427    *
428    * @return This object.
429    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If it does not.
430    */
431   public RunEvent validate() {
432      var len = JsonSerializer.DEFAULT.toString(toContractMap()).length();
433      if (len > MAX_EVENT_CHARS)
434         throw iaex("RunEvent serialized size must be <= %s chars; got %s", MAX_EVENT_CHARS, len);
435      return this;
436   }
437
438   /**
439    * Builds an event from its wire form.
440    *
441    * <p>
442    * The strict inverse of {@link #toContractMap()}.  Unknown members are ignored; an unknown <c>ev</c> or a
443    * malformed known member throws.
444    *
445    * @param map The wire map.
446    * @return A new event.
447    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is not a valid event.
448    */
449   @SuppressWarnings({
450      "java:S3776" // Validating every wire member is inherently branchy.
451   })
452   public static RunEvent fromMap(Map<?,?> map) {
453      if (map == null)
454         throw iaex("RunEvent map must not be null");
455      var ev = map.get("ev");
456      if (! (ev instanceof String evs))
457         throw iaex("RunEvent ev must be a string; got '%s'", ev);
458      RunEvent e;
459      switch (evs) {
460         case "step" -> {
461            e = step(str(map, "step", "id"), str(map, "step", "title"));
462            if (map.get("n") != null)
463               e = e.withN(toInt(map, "step", "n"));
464            if (map.get("status") != null)
465               e = e.withState(parse(StepState.class, "step", "status", map.get("status")));
466            if (map.get("rawOffset") != null)
467               e = e.withRawOffset(toLong(map, "step", "rawOffset"));
468         }
469         case "end" -> {
470            e = end(str(map, "end", "id"), parse(EndStatus.class, "end", "status", map.get("status")));
471            if (map.get("ms") != null)
472               e = e.withMs(toLong(map, "end", "ms"));
473            if (map.get("exit") != null)
474               e = e.withExit(toInt(map, "end", "exit"));
475         }
476         case "suite" -> {
477            if (! (map.get("counts") instanceof Map<?,?> c))
478               throw iaex("RunEvent suite counts must be an object; got '%s'", map.get("counts"));
479            e = suite(str(map, "suite", "step"), str(map, "suite", "fw"), str(map, "suite", "suite"),
480               toInt(c, "suite", "counts.pass"), toInt(c, "suite", "counts.fail"), toInt(c, "suite", "counts.skip"));
481            if (map.get("rawOffset") != null)
482               e = e.withRawOffset(toLong(map, "suite", "rawOffset"));
483         }
484         case "test" -> {
485            e = test(str(map, "test", "step"), str(map, "test", "fw"), str(map, "test", "suite"), str(map, "test", "name"),
486               parse(TestStatus.class, "test", "status", map.get("status")));
487            if (map.get("ms") != null)
488               e = e.withMs(toLong(map, "test", "ms"));
489            if (map.get("msg") != null)
490               e = e.withMsg(str(map, "test", "msg"));
491            if (map.get("trace") != null)
492               e = e.withTrace(str(map, "test", "trace"));
493            if (map.get("rawOffset") != null)
494               e = e.withRawOffset(toLong(map, "test", "rawOffset"));
495         }
496         case "replace" -> e = replace(str(map, "replace", "step"));
497         case "note" -> {
498            e = note(parse(Level.class, "note", "level", map.get("level")), str(map, "note", "text"));
499            if (map.get("href") != null)
500               e = e.withHref(str(map, "note", "href"));
501            if (map.get("step") != null)
502               e = e.withStep(str(map, "note", "step"));
503         }
504         case "done" -> e = done(parse(DoneStatus.class, "done", "status", map.get("status")));
505         default -> throw iaex("RunEvent ev must be one of step, end, suite, test, replace, note, done; got '%s'", RunViewChecks.clip(evs));
506      }
507      if (map.get("seq") != null)
508         e = e.withSeq(toLong(map, evs, "seq"));
509      return e.validate();
510   }
511
512   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
513   // Helpers
514   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
515
516   private static String wireName(Kind k) {
517      return k.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
518   }
519
520   private void requireKind(String member, Kind...allowed) {
521      for (var k : allowed)
522         if (k == kind)
523            return;
524      throw iaex("RunEvent %s does not have a '%s' member", wireName(kind), member);
525   }
526
527   private static String wire(String ev, String member, Enum<?> value) {
528      if (value == null)
529         throw iaex("RunEvent %s %s must not be null", ev, member);
530      return value.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
531   }
532
533   private static <E extends Enum<E>> E parse(Class<E> type, String ev, String member, Object value) {
534      if (value instanceof String s) {
535         for (var c : type.getEnumConstants())
536            if (c.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).equals(s))
537               return c;
538      }
539      throw iaex("RunEvent %s %s must be one of %s; got '%s'", ev, member,
540         Arrays.stream(type.getEnumConstants()).map(c -> c.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)).toList(), value instanceof String s ? RunViewChecks.clip(s) : String.valueOf(value));
541   }
542
543   private static String stepId(String ev, String member, String value) {
544      if (! RunViewChecks.isStepId(value))
545         throw iaex("RunEvent %s %s must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$; got '%s'", ev, member, RunViewChecks.clip(value));
546      return value;
547   }
548
549   private static String fw(String ev, String value) {
550      if (! RunViewChecks.isFw(value))
551         throw iaex("RunEvent %s fw must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$; got '%s'", ev, RunViewChecks.clip(value));
552      return value;
553   }
554
555   private static String text(String ev, String member, String value, int min, int max) {
556      if (value == null || value.length() < min || value.length() > max)
557         throw iaex("RunEvent %s %s must be %s-%s chars; got %s", ev, member, min, max, value == null ? "null" : value.length() + " chars");
558      return value;
559   }
560
561   private static int count(String member, int value) {
562      if (value < 0 || value > MAX_COUNT)
563         throw iaex("RunEvent suite counts.%s must be 0-%s; got '%s'", member, MAX_COUNT, value);
564      return value;
565   }
566
567   private static String str(Map<?,?> map, String ev, String member) {
568      var v = map.get(member);
569      if (! (v instanceof String s))
570         throw iaex("RunEvent %s %s must be a string; got '%s'", ev, member, v);
571      return s;
572   }
573
574   private static long toLong(Map<?,?> map, String ev, String member) {
575      var key = member.contains(".") ? member.substring(member.indexOf('.') + 1) : member;
576      var v = map.get(key);
577      if (v instanceof Long || v instanceof Integer || v instanceof Short || v instanceof Byte)
578         return ((Number)v).longValue();
579      if (v instanceof Number n) {
580         var d = n.doubleValue();
581         if (d == Math.rint(d) && Math.abs(d) <= MAX_SAFE_INT)
582            return (long)d;
583      }
584      throw iaex("RunEvent %s %s must be an integer; got '%s'", ev, member, v);
585   }
586
587   private static int toInt(Map<?,?> map, String ev, String member) {
588      var l = toLong(map, ev, member);
589      if (l < Integer.MIN_VALUE || l > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
590         throw iaex("RunEvent %s %s must fit in 32 bits; got '%s'", ev, member, l);
591      return (int)l;
592   }
593
594   @Override /* Object */
595   public boolean equals(Object o) {
596      return o instanceof RunEvent e && kind == e.kind && seq == e.seq && toContractMap().equals(e.toContractMap());
597   }
598
599   @Override /* Object */
600   public int hashCode() {
601      return Objects.hash(kind, seq, toContractMap());
602   }
603
604   @Override /* Object */
605   public String toString() {
606      return toContractMap().toString();
607   }
608}
